messages:
Elaine: Heads-up  dashboard flagged a big MQL bump for the APAC launch cohort (starts 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC). Can someone validate source before Friday's KPI review? https://dash.redwood.ai/kpi?view=launch-cohort :eyes:

growth-bot: Alert: MQL +48% vs 7d baseline. CPL -12%. Top ref: partner-labs. Spike detected at 02:07 UTC. (id gb-9843)

Mike: Seeing same in GA. High sessions with utm_source=partner-labs and utm_campaign=mar-launch-aps. Was there a partners push Saturday night?

Sophia: We did a partner mail-out with an A/B test on subject lines. Did ops run the full list or a subset?

James: Ran a quick DB check: ```SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE received_at >= '2026-03-19' AND utm_source='partner-labs'; -- 1274``` Looks like an import/bulk hit rather than organic conversions.

Elaine: If it's an import duplicate, weekly MQL metrics will be inflated. Need confirmation before we ship slides.

analytics-bot: SFDC import record: import_2026_03_19_0205.csv uploaded by ops@partners at 02:05 UTC, 1,280 rows processed, no parsing errors.

Mike: That tracks with DB numbers. Next: confirm dedupe status (emails/phones) and whether these were new leads or re-uploads.

Sophia: If partners re-sent a previously delivered list, attribution will misleadingly credit partner-labs. We should flag these rows as "partner-batch" and exclude dupes from KPI baselines.

James: Proposed action items: 1) analytics to run dedupe (email+phone) and return counts, 2) ops to confirm source/intent of CSV, 3) update dashboard filters and recalc baseline for Friday.

Elaine: Can someone pull GA sessions 02:00-03:00 UTC and the raw SFDC import file for the triage? I want to confirm UTM consistency and overlap.

analytics-bot: Export queued: ga_sessions_2026-03-19_0200-0300.csv (ETA 6m).

Mike: I'll take dedupe query and post diff by 14:30 UTC.

Sophia: I'll ping ops and partners to confirm whether the CSV was a resend or a new list. If resend, we'll prepare an appendix note for the KPI slides.

Elaine: Great. Quick sync at 15:30 UTC to confirm findings? 10 minutes max.

James: 15:30 UTC works. I'll bring sample rows and dedupe SQL.

Mike: +1

Sophia: +1 :thumbsup:

growth-bot: Calendar invite created: "APAC MQL spike triage" 2026-03-19 15:30 UTC. Participants invited.
